Add $50 of liquidity to Nucleus's deepest pool on Plume Mainnet and leave it in. Cost: $50 of capital and about $4 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Take a second qualifying action of a different kind, such as a swap, a borrow or a vote, so the wallet shows breadth. Cost: about $2 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.
Make one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 30 days.
Open the protocol's own points or rewards page once a week and write down the balance you see. Cost: nothing to check. Time: 5 minutes a week.
Before you withdraw, check the claim link on the protocol's own page and never pay to claim. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
Unwind in reverse order: withdraw, then bridge back, and keep the log for the next farm. Cost: about $4 of gas. Time: 15 minutes.
